speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when your fever and headache first started?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you consume any unpasteurized dairy products or soft cheeses, such as brie or feta, in the days leading up to your symptoms? I also need to know if you have experienced any abdominal pain or contractions recently.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any vaginal bleeding, fluid leakage, or a decrease in fetal movement? I need to assess the safety of the pregnancy immediately.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Unremarkable. The patient is currently pregnant, at her 30th week of gestation. Social history: Non-smoker, does not consume alcohol. No recent travels or contact with sick individuals. No known allergies.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a stiff neck, sensitivity to light, or any confusion, which would suggest meningitis? I also need to know if you have had any recent urinary symptoms like burning or frequency, or a cough and shortness of breath.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies cough, shortness of breath, abdominal pain, diarrhea, or urinary symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your symptoms and the recent consumption of ice cream, I suspect a foodborne illness like Listeria. REQUEST TEST: Blood Culture, Listeria Monocytogenes Serology.
